title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. One of my friend's kid need to undergo surgery (Cochlear Implantation Surgery) to get hearing ability. The cost of operation will be more than 6 LAKHS. Father of this kid cannot afford this cost, as he is hailing from poor family. From our friend's circle, we would like to contribute for this surgery. Can our contribution be given with Zakkaat Niyyath? Will it be accepted as Zakkat? Patient family is muslim and father's earning is very less. Please pray for this kid. 2028 views Q. Using zakah fund for mosque construction 2340 views Q. zakat for madarsa 4477 views Q. Zakaat on property purchased without any firm intention. 2579 views Q. He is retired and ill. He has one own house recently purchased with some Credit. His son 24 yrs doing job private and helping to the family, He wants to go to gulf for this he needs some money for the visa. I have some amount with me for Zakath, can I give him, I think he is (my Brother)not saheb-e-nisaab. 1882 views Q. If I give (pay ) zakat (2.5 % of my earnings)every month, should I pay another 2.5% of my saving after one year also. 2196 views Q. I have acquired three small pieces of land recently with the intention that these investments will mature in the long run to enable myself to build a house. I am confused about paying zakat on these lands.I would like to know if you purchase land for the purpose of building a house in the distant future may be on the same or some other property by selling this one do you have to pay zakat on it? Is it right for me to pay zakat on selection of them or two of them and mark one as reserved for house building? Also is there a one year grace period before zakat becomes due ? please advise. 2972 views Q. Is zakah to be given separately for wife and husband's wealth? 5741 views Q. My wife is having 640 grams Gold ornaments. Last year I have calculated and paid zakath for this. This year I purchased 16 grams of gold ornament. Now I have 2 questions : (1). Last year I paid zakath for 640 grams, so Is it farz to pay this year also ? or is it enough to pay zakath for only the newly bought 16 grams gold? or to pay zakath for the whole 640 16 grams? (2). Is it Farz for the husband to pay zakath for wife's Gold ornaments ? 4560 views Q. ZAKAT 1608 views Q. We have open a society/trust to Work for the Educational Upliftment of Muslims.Can we use the ZAKAT money in it? 1606 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 42718 Country: India Title: Is it allowed to give zakat to buy the land for madarsa Question: In our village we have a mosque. Recently we the villagers bought some land adjacent to the mosque for the purpose to build a madrasa and paid some amount in cash and some in loan. My question is that can we villagers give our zakah to pay the loan taken for this land? Answer ID: 42718 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1742/1742/M=1433) No, the money of zakah cannot be used in buying land for madrasa, since the money is not given in the possession of a poor which is necessary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
